---
title: Canary
description: The home page of the broken canary tree.
---

This tree is built by the real-Jx canary test, and every kind of problem that a strict build must catch is in it once.

- A broken relative link: [the missing page](guide/missing.md).
- A missing image: ![Not here](assets/not-there.png)
- A reference-style link: [the guide][guide].
- A footnote.[^note]
- A raw HTML link: <a href="guide/tasks.md">the task page</a>.

[guide]: guide/tasks.md
[^note]: Footnotes are not supported by the site.
